verdict.rationale: A state business-filing system could plausibly offer a test or sandbox environment for API or e-filing integrations, so the axis applies. The evidence pack holds only robots.txt probes showing that crawling is disallowed, and none of it documents a sandbox, test environment, or isolation from production data. With no evidence of the capability, the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
